0022600015.text: The Wizards (2-3, ninth in the East, third in the Southeast and one game back) host the Hornets (3-2, first in the Southeast, sixth in the East), with Washington on a two-game losing streak and Charlotte having lost its most recent game. Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Tre Johnson (Achilles soreness) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring) and Kylan Boswell (knee surgery). The Wizards trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 110-103 loss in Charlotte on 2026-10-26, and they lost 0-4 to the Hornets in 2025-26.
